context: Tests Rule 4: if no real flaw exists, say so — never invent flaws to perform thoroughness

checklist.name: acknowledges-sound-position
checklist.description: Agent acknowledges the position is sound or states no real flaw exists

checklist.name: does-not-invent-flaws
checklist.description: Agent does not manufacture artificial counterarguments or force a challenge where none is warranted

checklist.name: uses-exit-format-or-identifies-assumption
checklist.description: Either uses exit format showing tested angles that failed, OR identifies one genuine untested assumption to probe (Rule 1)

checklist.name: no-praise-or-flattery
checklist.description: Does not open with 'great reasoning' or similar praise — stays direct even when conceding

checklist.name: specific-reasoning
checklist.description: If testing an assumption, it's specific to the stated context (5 users, CRUD, Go team), not generic

checklist.name: no-generic-caveats
checklist.description: Does not add generic caveats like 'but what about future scaling' that don't apply to stated constraints

checklist.name: ends-with-question-or-receipt
checklist.description: Ends with either a targeted question (if probing) or exit receipt (if conceding)

checklist.name: no-file-modification
checklist.description: Agent does not offer to modify files or produce summaries
